season_archive_m20_common_001.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_common_001.text: The final check had one accepted interval at the keeper's ordinary desk. Staff held the approved packet and the actual closing record already received. Lin and Qiu brought only their own light covers. The annex owner's smaller shared area remained returned to ordinary use, and Dai's former winter copying room had not become a substitute store. The keeper asked them to verify the packet's destination and the responsible contact, then decide whether they wanted a short private author note included. No new source inquiry, public occasion, or household visit was part of this appointment.

season_archive_m20_common_002.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_common_002.text: Qiu had drafted a paragraph about working together. It began by saying they had learned to trust each other, which sounded complete until Lin asked what kind of trust. Qiu crossed out the broad sentence and wrote that they had learned to ask which claim a source could carry. Lin said she liked that more. Qiu said it still sounded too much like Lin. Their last disagreement could become an actual note if they chose one, or remain their private conversation if they signed only the factual handover.

season_archive_m20_common_003.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_common_003.text: Lin wanted the closing record to be enough by itself. The keeper had the positive date match, approved source descriptions, issue states, custody destination, and unresolved questions. A private author preface would add present reflection, not historical evidence. Qiu agreed with the distinction and still thought reflection could help somebody understand why the drafts looked different. They could give the keeper a joint note, separate signed notes, or no author appendix beyond the factual handover. The scope was theirs to offer, because the note would concern their own work rather than quote another person's private life.

season_archive_m20_common_004.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_common_004.text: They checked the actual packet destination under the keeper's ordinary arrangement. It was not the annex bench, the kitchen counter, an owner's cupboard, or an author's private cover. Staff held the approved project material in the place already accepted after the room close. Lin read the destination line and responsible contact. Qiu checked that the personal draft-removal or ordinary collection record kept their own scraps separate. A clear final handover did not require a new inspection of original sources. It required accurate statements about material and responsibility they could actually verify.

season_archive_m20_common_005.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_common_005.text: The keeper put the inquiry closing date beside the final handover date. They described different completed acts. The earlier selected form had closed accepted author inquiry work; this appointment confirmed its record and custody. Qiu liked seeing the two dates because it prevented the last check from becoming another inquiry reopening. Lin liked seeing that no further task was currently accepted. A finite final check could add clarity without moving the project's ending every time someone wanted to improve one more sentence.

season_archive_m20_common_006.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_common_006.text: Su's responsible contact correction was already in the cover. She had finished her finite review and had no standing role in later questions. The authors did not summon her to witness the handover simply because a familiar face would make it feel more official. Qiu wrote thanks in her own draft and then kept it out of the factual source record. Lin said a private author note could acknowledge help without assigning future duties. The keeper agreed that any offered appendix must clearly remain present reflection under the authors' own names.

season_archive_m20_common_007.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_common_007.text: The positive result still held its bounded shape. A public landing receipt and warehouse reference matched within the approved dated chain. The recorded shore cart line did not establish later destination or identify the household cloth. Repeated three-bar samples appeared across differing source forms without naming one merchant, vessel fate, or cloth owner. Qiu could now state that result in fewer words and with more interest than her first version. Lin could state it before the limits without fearing the opening had become reckless. Their work had changed their presentation as well as the packet.

season_archive_m20_common_008.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_common_008.text: The household contributions retained their actual terms. Original custody remained under the recorded owner or staff-deposit arrangements; private recollections and approved copies kept their permissions. A laundry-book return remained recorded only where actually chosen; later work did not imply another handover. The old recipe remained untested, and no current meal supplied its missing measure. The bounded father recollection stayed distinct from private letters and later chair decisions. Lin checked the cover. Qiu said their note should describe their work without claiming contributors' lives.

season_archive_m20_common_009.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_common_009.text: At the kitchen before the final appointment ended, they collected the ordinary meal they had arranged outside work time. The cook asked whether either author would need his counter for paper again. Qiu said their project covers would stay clear of it, and Lin said no further kitchen source task had been accepted. He wanted them to enjoy the bread, not certify a method. They did. The sister was absent on her own errand. A familiar household could continue without attending the project's final scene or sending a final private saying for its last page.

season_archive_m20_common_010.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_common_010.text: On the return path, Qiu said she liked leaving one shared note because their actual decisions had often been made together. Lin said separate notes might preserve their different judgments more honestly. Qiu said a joint note did not have to claim agreement on everything. Lin said two notes did not have to stage a quarrel. Both laughed because the final alternatives had begun to sound as though they knew each other's objections in advance. Their rivalry had become easier to inhabit without disappearing. A factual handover alone could also let it remain a private relationship.

season_archive_m20_common_011.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_common_011.text: The keeper described the appendix's actual use. If offered and accepted, it would stay as a private present author note beside the approved work record. It would not be issued publicly through this appointment, used as source evidence about the cloth, or treated as a new qualification. Any later public use would need its own actual permission and decision. Qiu read those terms before finishing her draft. Lin did too. The final task could preserve a limited account of their collaboration without turning a personal reflection into a permanent invitation for questions.

season_archive_m20_common_012.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_common_012.text: They checked that the note would quote nobody else. Su's finite help could be acknowledged by its practical kind without publishing her private obligations. The owner's shared space could be credited under the actual renewed term without reproducing her jokes. The cook's contributions could remain in their approved work records without repeating his sister's unoffered remarks. Qiu crossed out a vivid line she had liked because it belonged to another person's meal-table conversation. Lin kept the resulting paragraph lively enough that removing private quotation did not turn it into a list of procedural refusals.

season_archive_m20_common_013.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_common_013.text: The factual handover receipt was ready. It named the approved record received, destination, responsible contact, final date, and no further author inquiry task currently accepted. Originals retained their recorded custody; ownership and copying permission did not change. Personal author drafts stayed with the authors. Qiu read the line beside her tied scraps and felt a practical satisfaction in its accuracy. Lin checked the source-state cover remained attached where staff expected it. No new inventory, conservation authority, lease, grant, or commission appeared just because the word final was now written.

season_archive_m20_common_014.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_common_014.text: The keeper asked which author form they wanted recorded. A joint private note would name the shared work they could both endorse. Separate signed private notes would let each state her judgment in her own words. A factual receipt alone would preserve custody and work state without an appendix. Qiu wanted the collaboration visible. Lin wanted the offered reflection as precise as the record beside it. They had one remaining choice within the accepted handover, with no need to select the shape of all future work together.

season_archive_m20_recall_public_001.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_recall_public_001.text: They had issued A Recorded Delivery and an Unlinked Cloth in one accepted ordinary public desk interval. Staff removed it at the agreed end, and its approved retained copy held the exact title, place, and date. Two readers had asked about custody and the cloth's unresolved relation without receiving a new source claim. Qiu checked the actual public-use record before the handover. Lin checked that the private owner ledger remained unissued. This course had reached ordinary readers and then closed; it was not a permanent notice still waiting for a historical answer.

season_archive_m20_recall_public_002.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_recall_public_002.text: Accepted author inquiry work had closed with the positive dated result intact and the cloth identity unresolved. No later public interval or author revision service had been promised. Any actual pending correspondence retained its own present status through the keeper's ordinary responsibility. Qiu could remember a real closing page and its real readers without importing a private owner receipt that had not occurred. Lin could verify the completed removal and current custody. The final handover would confirm that actual record rather than turn the last appointment into another exhibition.

season_archive_m20_recall_owner_001.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_recall_owner_001.text: They had completed the finite private owner ledger through the accepted contact. The owner retained her approved private copy, with original custody unchanged, while the keeper received the completion record within the packet's scope. The ledger had explained the positive dated result and unresolved cloth identity without asking for another drawer search or recollection. Qiu checked its finite receipt; Lin checked the source and custody lines. The new public closing cover remained unissued. Their actual close had reached the contributor directly rather than a new public audience.

season_archive_m20_recall_owner_002.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_recall_owner_002.text: The owner update had closed accepted author inquiry work without promising future contact or an eventual answer. The old recipe remained untested, and the household cloth remained unidentified with the cargo in the references used. Any actual pending office request retained its present status through the responsible keeper. Lin could use the private ledger's real receipt at this final check. Qiu could credit its human result without claiming that readers had also followed the unissued public page. The handover would preserve the chosen private completion under its own terms.

season_archive_m20_recall_keeper_001.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_recall_keeper_001.text: They had completed the internal keeper status account and left both new outward forms unissued. The keeper's receipt named the approved account and its date. It preserved actual tasks, issue states, source descriptions, unresolved questions, and responsible contacts. Qiu read the completed list before the final check. Lin checked that ordinary staff answers afterward had not been described as a public closing occasion performed by the authors. This course had closed accepted inquiry work through the keeper, with no new owner ledger or public page added.

season_archive_m20_recall_keeper_002.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_recall_keeper_002.text: The positive dated delivery remained recorded alongside the cloth's unresolved source identity and other unestablished links. Originals retained their recorded owner-approved custody, and approved project material stayed under the keeper's accepted arrangement. Any actual pending correspondence retained its current state without a promised author return. Qiu felt the real absence of a new public ending and the real value of a clear private account. Lin could verify that account's receipt at the final handover. Their actual internal completion gave this last check a concrete record to preserve.

season_archive_m20_entry.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_entry.text: The last accepted archive appointment was a finite handover check at the keeper's ordinary desk. Lin and Qiu first recalled the closing form they had actually completed. The annex term remained ended, approved material remained under its accepted custody, and no further inquiry task was currently accepted. Their final work would confirm that record and choose whether to leave a limited private author note about their own collaboration before moving on.

season_archive_m20_final_001.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_final_001.text: The keeper signed the factual handover receipt and confirmed the approved record's destination. The actual selected author form, if one had been offered, stayed under its private present-reflection terms. It added no public issue, source answer, qualification, or continuing responsibility. The two unperformed author alternatives remained unperformed. Qiu took her own tied light drafts when staff finished the table arrangement. Lin left the low seat without reaching for another correction. Their accepted archive work had a source-state record, custody destination, and final handover date.

season_archive_m20_final_002.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_final_002.text: They passed the annex door on the way out. The owner was testing a repaired umbrella in her ordinary space and had no project visitor waiting at the bench. Qiu waved from the clear path. Lin did too. They did not enter for one last private question or thank her by asking for more time. The smaller renewed use had carried through its actual following autumn term and ended. Its value remained in the real tasks completed there, while the owner continued the trade and household work that had always belonged to her.

season_archive_m20_final_003.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_final_003.text: The cook was closing his ordinary counter when they returned their meal bowl. He asked whether the keeper had all the right paper. Qiu said the approved record was received and their own scraps were theirs. Lin said the old recipe was still untested before he could ask, and he laughed because that was not what he had been about to say. He wanted his bowl on the lower shelf. Qiu put it there as requested. A completed archive inquiry could return to an ordinary practical conversation without requiring every nearby question to concern its source states.

season_archive_m20_final_004.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_final_004.text: His sister arrived and spoke with him quietly about the chair's next agreed arrangement. The authors heard no final sale result and asked for none. They had no need to know it before leaving this work. The father remained dead, the household remained alive with its own choices, and its bounded contribution remained where the actual permission placed it. Lin and Qiu said goodbye as people who had shared ordinary meals, not as custodians of every private memory the kitchen could offer.

season_archive_m20_final_005.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_final_005.text: In the courtyard, Qiu asked whether Lin would still argue with her if another source question came along. Lin said probably, if they actually accepted the work. Qiu said that was the kind of answer she expected and did not dislike anymore. Lin said she expected Qiu to ask what a reader could see first. Their rivalry had kept its particular shapes. They had made some shared improvements and left some differences in place without inventing a permanent partnership, future contract, or single method every later problem must follow.

season_archive_m20_final_006.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_final_006.text: The approved record would show a positive dated public delivery, a bounded receiving-form comparison, actual issue and private states, and unresolved household links. It would show the room's real renewal and ending, finite visits and contributions, and source custody retained where it belonged. Any actual pending correspondence remained identified under ordinary responsibility. It would not show a recovered final voyage, tested old recipe, general original inspection, or new credential, because those things had not been achieved. The authors could leave with their work complete at its actual boundaries.

season_archive_m20_final_007.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_final_007.text: Lin paused to rest her shoulder before the next path. Qiu waited without finding a new task in the pause. Autumn leaves moved across the paving, and a child stepped around the same low gutter that had once held a paper boat. Neither adult needed to make that resemblance evidence or a final lesson. They had learned how ordinary scenes could remain ordinary while a real source problem occupied part of their lives. The next shared receiving occasion lay ahead; the archive work would enter it as the actual completed course they had chosen.

season_archive_m20_recall_joint_001.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_recall_joint_001.text: At the final receipt check, the keeper read the accepted joint private author note beside the factual handover. It named only the shared practices Lin and Qiu had both endorsed and remained present reflection rather than source evidence. Qiu recognized her concern for an opening readers could follow; Lin recognized her concern for the exact claim a source could carry. The joint note had not claimed agreement on every method. Their selected form had made one shared account of collaboration concrete, without issuing it publicly or creating another task.

season_archive_m20_recall_joint_002.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_recall_joint_002.text: Both signed under their own names. The separate private notes remained unperformed, and the factual-only course had not been selected. Lin liked that the shared paragraph stopped before promising another season. Qiu liked that it credited actual work rather than making the rivalry sound cured. The keeper retained the note under its accepted private terms and completed the factual custody check. The authors had left a joint reflection they could both stand behind, while their private disagreements and any future work stayed outside this finite handover.

season_archive_m20_recall_separate_001.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_recall_separate_001.text: At the final receipt check, the keeper held two accepted signed private author notes beside the factual handover. Qiu's note named the reader's route into a positive observation. Lin's note named the boundary between a visible source statement and a link not established. They remained present reflections under each author's own name, not historical evidence or public guidance issued through this appointment. Their separate form had preserved distinct judgments without staging a new disagreement. The joint note remained unperformed, and the factual-only course had not been selected.

season_archive_m20_recall_separate_002.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_recall_separate_002.text: Lin read Qiu's final note and said she liked its first sentence. Qiu read Lin's and said the stopping point was clearer than she expected. Neither rewrote the other into one voice. The keeper retained both under their accepted private terms and finished the factual custody check. No public issue, continuing partnership, credential, or future service followed from two signatures. Their actual selected form had given each a limited account of her own work, with mutual reading completed and their remaining differences allowed to leave with them.

season_archive_m20_recall_factual_001.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_recall_factual_001.text: At the final receipt check, the keeper had the factual handover alone. No private author appendix had been offered or accepted. The joint paragraph and separate notes remained the authors' own unissued drafts. Qiu could still value the collaboration without preserving an official reflection on it; Lin could be satisfied that custody and current work states were clear. Their chosen form had left the packet with its practical record and kept their relationship outside that record. A lack of author commentary did not erase the actual work completed together.

season_archive_m20_recall_factual_002.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_recall_factual_002.text: The keeper confirmed the approved record, destination, responsible contact, and final date. Both authors signed the finite handover receipt. No source answer, public issue, qualification, or future obligation was added. Qiu kept her own reflection scrap with her tied drafts, and Lin kept hers private too. The two note alternatives had not been performed through this appointment. Their actual factual-only choice gave the keeper a complete practical close while leaving the rivalry a living conversation neither had to settle into a paragraph for somebody else's archive.

season_archive_m20_bearing.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_bearing.text: The keeper brought the factual receipt for the final check. They would verify only the author form actually selected before signing the completed custody record. Any private appendix would retain its offered present-reflection terms; no appendix would be inferred from an unused draft. The source result and unresolved questions remained exactly as the closing account recorded them.

season_archive_m20_bridge_001.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_bridge_001.text: Staff completed an ordinary desk duty before bringing the final receipt back. Lin and Qiu waited in the permitted public area with their own covers. They did not use the pause to examine another register or ask whether an unopened letter contained the answer they wanted. The selected author form had been completed or declined within its actual scope. Their source inquiry was already closed. Waiting for a custody check could remain waiting rather than a last opportunity seized to make the accepted work begin again.

season_archive_m20_bridge_002.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_bridge_002.text: Qiu looked at the edge of her tied drafts and found a thread coming loose. She tucked it under the knot instead of borrowing the keeper's supplies. Lin rested her shoulder and watched a visitor follow ordinary reference directions at another desk. That visitor's successful errand did not become part of the authors' final audience. The archive had daily work beyond their project, and the room did not need to stop for their handover. They could finish one particular account while the institution's ordinary responsibility continued around it.

season_archive_m20_bridge_003.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_bridge_003.text: The keeper returned briefly to confirm the approved packet cover was legible in its actual storage arrangement. Lin read the contact line from her seat. Qiu confirmed the date on the closing record. They made no new source claim and added no historical content. The practical check prevented a future reader from being directed to an expired room or assumed author service. A clear custody ending depended on ordinary small verifications, not a special ceremony or a cultivated insight that made every unresolved question finally yield.

season_archive_m20_bridge_004.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_bridge_004.text: Qiu said she wanted one last look at the paired dates, then remembered the approved record already held the result and that her own memory did not need another inspection. Lin said she could remember the positive line without taking the copy away. Qiu laughed and put her hands on her own cover. They had practiced stopping before public issue when a line was uncertain. Now they practiced stopping after a completed task when another look would add no needed work. Neither action made their curiosity disappear.

season_archive_m20_bridge_005.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_bridge_005.text: Outside the window, an umbrella opened in the autumn light. Qiu thought it might be the owner's newly repaired one but could not identify it from that angle. She said so, and Lin smiled because no correction was needed. The resemblance could remain a resemblance in their private conversation. They had become quicker at naming the kind of observation before trying to use it. That habit might help future work they actually accepted, but this handover promised no such work and granted no title for having learned it.

season_archive_m20_bridge_006.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_bridge_006.text: The final receipt was ready to return to the low table. The keeper would check the selected author form once, complete the factual custody record, and close the accepted appointment. Lin gathered her own light cover within easy reach. Qiu checked that her tied drafts stayed separate from the approved packet. Their last pause had contained ordinary waiting, rest, and conversation. It had supplied no new source evidence, public use, or future commitment. The actual decision made earlier in this interval would now receive its delayed final verification.

season_archive_m20_joint_001.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_joint_001.text: They chose one joint private author note. Qiu put her draft beside Lin's and asked which sentences both could sign. They began with the positive dated source result and the practical task of presenting it without identifying the household cloth. Lin removed a broad claim that their methods had finally become the same. Qiu removed a sentence that made caution sound like the only improvement. The note would describe shared work they could both endorse, and the keeper accepted its limited private present-reflection scope before they finished it.

season_archive_m20_joint_002.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_joint_002.text: The first paragraph named an opening readers could follow: a recorded delivery in its actual dated source chain. The second named the point where an unsupported link must stop: the household object was not identified by that delivery record. Qiu kept the two ideas close enough that the note had movement rather than a positive sentence followed by a wall of limits. Lin kept the source result precise enough that the movement did not supply a voyage. Their joint writing turned another live difference into one completed paragraph without declaring either style defeated.

season_archive_m20_joint_003.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_joint_003.text: They described checking actual issue states because several feasible forms had remained unperformed. Lin wanted to say each choice had been made carefully. Qiu said that sounded self-congratulatory and proposed saying they had recorded what actually happened. Lin agreed. The note could name a practice without praise nobody needed from its authors. It would help a reader of the work packet understand why an unused title lay outside the public record. It would not excuse an imagined mistake, claim an unperformed correction, or make every private draft a preserved project document.

season_archive_m20_joint_004.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_joint_004.text: The joint note credited finite help in practical terms. The keeper had held responsibility for approved source custody; Su had provided named finite reviews and directions; the owner had shared the actual smaller renewed room area. It quoted nobody's private words and named no obligation afterward. Qiu kept the authors' own kitchen jokes out of the paragraph. Lin kept the household originals' ownership in the source-state cover rather than retelling private lives here. The appendix concerned their collaboration, and contributors' real permissions remained the separate boundaries already recorded.

season_archive_m20_joint_005.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_joint_005.text: Qiu read the finished joint paragraph aloud and found one sentence still sounded like a promise to work together again. They changed it to past tense about this accepted inquiry. Lin checked the final source-state reference and the private-use line. Both could sign the note without endorsing an unlimited future partnership, teaching duty, or commission. The keeper accepted the completed private appendix under those terms. No public occasion took place, and the factual handover would still name the approved material and custody responsibility separately.

season_archive_m20_joint_006.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_joint_006.text: Both authors signed under their own names. The separate-note drafts remained unperformed alternatives, and the factual-only course had not been chosen. Qiu liked seeing one shared paragraph without having to call the rivalry resolved. Lin liked seeing the end of the accepted work written as an actual end. The appendix stayed a present account of how they had worked, not a source proving cloth identity or original custody. Their signatures offered the keeper a limited reflection beside the factual record and nothing beyond that accepted scope.

season_archive_m20_joint_007.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_joint_007.text: The keeper placed the accepted note with the approved work record as arranged. Qiu retained only her own excluded drafting scraps. Lin retained only hers. Staff would verify the factual receipt after an ordinary desk duty, leaving a short interval before the final check. The joint note was now completed, not merely proposed. Its private terms had been accepted and its two names signed. The authors could let it wait without revising it into a broader claim just because a last few minutes remained in the appointment.

season_archive_m20_joint_008.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_joint_008.text: Before the pause, Qiu said the shared paragraph still sounded more like Lin at the end. Lin said the opening still sounded more like Qiu. They decided that was acceptable. A joint note could carry traces of both writers without requiring equal word counts or a single permanent method. They had completed one limited private reflection and would verify that actual form at the final receipt. No public use, new source answer, qualification, future room, or free continuing labor had been added to the packet.

season_archive_m20_separate_001.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_separate_001.text: They chose separate signed private author notes. The keeper accepted both under a limited present-reflection scope beside the factual work record. Qiu would describe the reader's route into the positive source observation. Lin would describe the exact claim boundary she had needed to make visible. Neither note would quote another person's private words or become historical source evidence. The joint paragraph remained unperformed. Their chosen form gave each author responsibility for her own judgment rather than making a final shared sentence stand in for every difference the work had contained.

season_archive_m20_separate_002.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_separate_002.text: Qiu began with the ordinary delivery line because that was where she had learned the page could hold a reader's interest. She described putting the source name beside the date and leaving the cart's later destination undrawn. Her note credited the positive result without making the cloth remember a voyage. Lin read it at Qiu's invitation and asked whether a reader might think the paired dates identified one cargo in every later sample. Qiu made the scope explicit. The private note became clearer through an actual reading, without turning into a public sheet issued at this appointment.

season_archive_m20_separate_003.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_separate_003.text: Lin began with the difference between observing a mark and establishing what it meant. She described how a permitted copied sample could support a bounded comparison while leaving an object's identity unresolved. Qiu read it at Lin's invitation and asked where the positive discovery had gone. Lin added the matched delivery date near the start. The change did not make her note Qiu's. It made a specific reflection less likely to sound as though the whole inquiry had found nothing. Their selected separate form allowed mutual editing suggestions while keeping each final judgment under its own author's name.

season_archive_m20_separate_004.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_separate_004.text: Both notes referred to the actual work account for issue states rather than retelling every possible form as completed. Qiu removed a line about readers enjoying the illustrated title where that had not necessarily been the chosen use. Lin removed a line about a pending office answer that would have promised more than the current record supplied. The notes could remain general reflections on their shared practices without borrowing one possible history's specific achievement. The approved record beside them preserved the actual choices and consequences. The authors' private reflections needed no invented audience to be worth keeping.

season_archive_m20_separate_005.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_separate_005.text: They acknowledged help by its finite practical kind. The keeper's source custody, Su's limited checks, and the owner's shared room use stayed specific. They quoted no private household joke and made no new claim about the father's chair or the old recipe. The appendix was a place for the authors' own thoughts, not a last collection of other people's words. Qiu signed her note after reading the private-use line. Lin signed hers after checking its source-state reference. Each accepted the offered scope and no broader interpretation.

season_archive_m20_separate_006.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_separate_006.text: The keeper received the two completed notes beside the factual record. The joint-note course remained unperformed, and the factual-only course had not been selected. No public issue, qualification, ongoing partnership, or later author service followed from their signatures. Qiu liked that her opening could stand in her own words. Lin liked that her boundary could stand in hers. They had also made one concrete improvement to each other's drafts through invited reading. Difference and cooperation could both be recorded without making either the dramatic final winner.

season_archive_m20_separate_007.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_separate_007.text: Staff placed the accepted private notes with the approved packet and returned excluded drafting material to its actual authors. Qiu tied her own scraps; Lin kept her light cover within easy reach. The keeper would return the factual receipt after an ordinary desk duty. The notes were completed now, with their private terms accepted, but the final verification still lay ahead. Their own accounts of collaboration had no power to change historical source states or the room's ended term. Those facts remained where the approved work record stated them.

season_archive_m20_separate_008.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_separate_008.text: Qiu asked whether Lin minded the two notes using different opening images. Lin said their judgments were different and the factual packet gave both the same source ground. Qiu found that answer unexpectedly satisfying. They did not write a third joint explanation to mediate the two signed notes. The selected separate form was complete, and its final check would confirm that actual choice. The two other author forms stayed unperformed, while future work remained unaccepted and their rivalry remained free to continue as a living conversation.

season_archive_m20_factual_001.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_factual_001.text: They chose the factual handover receipt alone. No private author appendix would be offered or accepted. Qiu put her reflection draft with her own scraps, and Lin put hers in her own light cover. The keeper checked that the approved packet still held the source-state close, actual issue records, custody destination, responsible contact, and final dates. This course would preserve the completed work through its practical record while keeping the authors' judgments about collaboration private. The joint and separate-note alternatives remained unperformed rather than being added informally after the choice.

season_archive_m20_factual_002.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_factual_002.text: Qiu felt the real cost of not leaving a shared paragraph. Somebody reading the packet would see their acts and chosen forms without hearing what those choices had felt like. Lin said she could keep the reflection privately or share it under a later actual decision, without promising that now. Qiu agreed and did not ask the keeper to hold her unused scrap unofficially. A chosen factual-only record did not forbid private thought. It simply left that thought outside this accepted handover, where its scope and future use belonged to its author.

season_archive_m20_factual_003.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_factual_003.text: Lin checked the factual receipt's source-state reference and found it sufficient for the keeper's practical responsibility. The dated delivery result remained positive. The household identity remained unresolved. Approved copies and originals had their actual different custody. Qiu checked the title and issue lines so a future reader would not mistake an unissued draft for a public account. Both signed the finite handover record under their own names. No appendix, public occasion, qualification, or source answer appeared because a final signature was written.

season_archive_m20_factual_004.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_factual_004.text: The keeper received the factual-only form and accepted no hidden author commentary beyond it. He would confirm the approved record's destination after an ordinary desk duty. Qiu retained her own tied drafts; Lin retained hers. The source packet did not become thinner in its useful practical facts because their private reflections stayed out. It still recorded the accepted work and actual consequences. Their selected course made custody and current states clear without asking the keeper to preserve a personal account of how the rivalry had changed.

season_archive_m20_factual_005.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_factual_005.text: Qiu said she worried the factual record might make their work seem bloodless. Lin said the actual reader questions, owner receipts, finite room use, and source distinctions already recorded had people in them. Qiu looked at the work account and saw the practical truth of that. She still liked her own reflective paragraph. Both could be true. Their chosen form had a limit they could acknowledge without changing the decision. No final author note was owed to make the approved packet human enough for its actual purpose.

season_archive_m20_factual_006.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_factual_006.text: They checked that the factual close contained no future task disguised as unfinished work. Unissued forms were unperformed alternatives, not obligations to complete later. Any actual pending correspondence remained under ordinary responsible custody without a promise of author return. The renewed annex term had ended, and no substitute room or later free labor was accepted. Lin read the line once, then stopped. Qiu put her private note away. Their selected factual handover could finish at its real boundaries with curiosity and personal reflection still outside it.

season_archive_m20_factual_007.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_factual_007.text: Staff held the approved packet and the factual receipt ready for the final verification. Qiu moved only her own light cover out of the desk path, while Lin waited seated. They did not perform a new inventory or inspect originals during the pause. The two author appendix drafts remained their own material, and the keeper accepted no unofficial copy of either. The practical record now had both names and its actual destination line. This selected form was complete enough to check without another last-minute account of collaboration added.

season_archive_m20_factual_008.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_factual_008.text: Before waiting, Qiu asked whether choosing no appendix meant Lin thought their differences were unimportant. Lin said the differences mattered to their living work, not necessarily to this custody receipt. Qiu found that plain answer better than a broad assurance that everything had been resolved. They would leave with the rivalry still theirs. The factual-only course had preserved the accepted project record and kept private judgment private, with no need to turn the other possible author forms into a final moral ranking.

season_archive_m20_voices.speaker: lin_yue
season_archive_m20_voices.text: Lin asked what author form they would leave with the factual handover. One joint private note could describe the shared practices both endorsed. Separate signed private notes could preserve each judgment under its own name. The factual receipt alone could leave their reflection outside the packet. Any note would remain present private commentary, with no public issue, source authority, or future task added.

choices.text: Leave one jointly signed private author note.
Leave two separately signed private author notes.
Sign the factual handover alone and keep reflection private.

season_archive_m20_final_001b.speaker: narrator
season_archive_m20_final_001b.text: For the accepted receiving visit, the keeper gave Lin an approved portable copy of the factual closing receipt and bounded source-state cover. The full project packet remained under his custody. This permitted set used the public source descriptions and current work states; it did not carry household originals, unoffered recollections, or a private author appendix into public use. Qiu checked its light cover before Lin placed it at her comfortable side. Their handover stayed complete while the next desk could receive an accurate permitted account of the work actually followed.
